title: Scrum Master, Digital Claims
description:
Brightwater Mutual is a regional property and casualty insurer serving eleven states. Our Digital Claims group is four years into replacing a mainframe claims system, and runs six cross-functional delivery teams alongside a legacy operations group.

We are hiring a Scrum Master to serve two of those teams — one building the adjuster-facing claim intake experience, one working on the integrations that connect it to the legacy policy system.

What you'll do:
• Facilitate the Scrum events for two teams: daily standup, sprint planning, sprint review, and retrospective
• Coach the teams and the Product Owners toward better refinement, clearer acceptance criteria, and realistic sprint commitments
• Surface and remove impediments; escalate the ones the team cannot resolve, and track them until they are gone
• Protect the team from mid-sprint scope injection, including from executives
• Maintain flow metrics — velocity, cycle time, sprint goal attainment, escaped defects — and use them to start conversations, not to rate people
• Partner with the other Scrum Masters in a community of practice; participate in Scrum of Scrums for cross-team dependencies
• Support the Product Owner in keeping the product backlog ordered and visible, without owning it yourself
• Coach teams through conflict, and toward the honest retrospective rather than the comfortable one

What you'll bring:
• 3+ years as a Scrum Master or agile coach; regulated industry experience welcome
• Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I) required; PSM II or A-CSM a plus
• Working command of the Scrum Guide, and the judgment to know where your organization's practice departs from it and why
• Experience with Jira and with building dashboards people actually read
• Familiarity with scaling patterns (SAFe, LeSS, or Scrum of Scrums) — we borrow rather than adopt wholesale
• Facilitation skill above all: you will run meetings where the loudest person is not the one who needs to be heard
• You have no authority over anyone on your teams. Everything you accomplish, you accomplish by influence

Salary range $98,000–$126,000. Remote within our operating states, with quarterly travel to Columbus.
